svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a thin oxide covers everything: both active areas, a narrow capped gate with nitride blocks on its sidewalls, and a wide stack on the oxide-filled trench whose poly top is bare under the oxide. After it resist covers both active areas and leaves a window over the wide stack.

svg.text: Before: the spacer oxide over the whole slice (step 080)
Resist is coated over the spacer oxide, exposed
through the P+ implant reticle and developed.
areas, a window over the resistor
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
